agent_slug.label: Agent handle
agent_slug.info: Handle of the agent that chats with visitors, e.g. support-agent. You'll find it on the agent's page in AgentCloud.

lang.label: Language
lang.info: "Automatic" follows the store language and falls back to English when the widget has no translation for it.

title.label: Button label
title.info: Text shown under the chat button and used as its accessible name. Leave empty for the default.

initial_message.label: Welcome message
initial_message.info: First message shown when the chat opens. Leave empty for the default.

api_key.label: Public API key
api_key.info: Optional. Public key of your AgentCloud tenant: it routes the chat to your own workspace.

app_url.label: AgentCloud URL
app_url.info: Where the widget is loaded from. Change it only for testing.
